$description: Scaalus typography — a shortlist of modern, minimal, creative, professional and premium fonts, identified by their letterforms from Pinterest research ('modern minimal font', 'premium creative sans serif font branding', 'minimal premium typography instagram post design') and matched to free commercial fonts. Elements only: pick a pairing, design the visual fresh.

roles.display: Big headlines, numbers and covers only — character and impact.
roles.accent: Serif for 1–3 highlight words, quotes and testimonials.
roles.label: Short uppercase labels and pills.

rules.rule: Pick one pairing per visual. Max two font families, plus an optional accent serif for 1–3 words.
rules.why: More families look messy, not creative.

rules.rule: Rotate pairings like moods — don't use the same pairing on two posts in a row. Any pairing works with any colour mood.
rules.why: Variety keeps the feed creative while the colours keep it recognisable.

rules.rule: Supporting text, captions and lists always use the pairing's body (workhorse) font.
rules.why: Display, condensed, wide and serif accent fonts lose readability at small sizes.

rules.rule: Display fonts only at headline size. Condensed only in uppercase headlines of 2–6 words. Syncopate only for short uppercase labels.
rules.why: These fonts are built for size and impact, not reading.

rules.rule: Accent serifs (Instrument Serif, Fraunces, Playfair Display) colour 1–3 words — ideally the same words that get the highlight colour.
rules.why: One premium contrast moment per post, not a second voice.

rules.rule: Tighten big headlines slightly (about −1% to −3% letter-spacing); track only uppercase labels wide.
rules.why: Tight headlines read premium; wide lowercase looks amateur.

rules.rule: Never use script, handwritten, distressed, novelty or decorative fonts for words.
rules.why: They break the minimal, professional, premium tone.

rules.rule: Never retype the Scaalus name in any font — always use the logo files.
rules.why: The wordmark is part of the logo and is never redrawn.

rules.rule: Use only fonts on this list, loaded from their official source (Google Fonts or Fontshare).
rules.why: All are free for commercial use; other fonts may need paid licences.
